lines.text: Netflix is currently developing a series adaptation of Hannah Grace’s bestselling novel Icebreaker, which kicks off the Maple Hill book series.
Production is underway on the college hockey romance drama, though a release date has not yet been set.
Daisy Jelley (Poser, How To Have Sex) stars as Anastasia “Stassie” Allen, a transfer athlete aiming for Olympic gold.
Connor Simos (Subversion) portrays Nate Hawkins, a campus star pursuing the NHL.
